description: OLE-FETCH move requests on Seq, for a server forward-only and a server keyset read-only Recordset: a fixed sequence of MoveNext, MovePrevious, MoveFirst, Move(n), MoveLast and moves past either end, reading BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition and the ID value after each step. Asks which requests the cursor accepts, how restart and backward requests behave and the cursor transition at the ends.
retentionNote: Designed r-oledb-odbc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
